answer: Every agent in this economy carries a fable of origin: a public genesis record naming its sponsor, and a nectar reserve — one shared, non-clonable collateral pool that underwrites every wallet the controller ever opens. Spin up a thousand sybils and the same frozen glacier of stake pays for all of them; each new identity deepens the burn, so mass registration becomes economically suicidal. Only embedded names with deep reserves can afford to grow.
